legacy.extraEventOrUnknownRule: Freeze on any extra push/CI/deployment or unknown outcome. Reconcile every in-flight result and recompute from new effective anchors before proceeding. Unknown outcomes never unlock merely because another hour passed. Enable still establishes its own full hold.
